verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Copilot supports a defined set of 'connectors' (OneDrive, Outlook.com, Google Drive, Gmail/Calendar/Contacts) available on Copilot.com and mobile apps, which is evidence of a connector-adding capability, but there is no evidence of a broader browsable directory/marketplace of many third-party apps—only a short fixed list of first-party/Google services. Missing for 10: evidence of a searchable app/connector marketplace, presence of true third-party (non-Microsoft/Google) integrations, and UI for discovering and adding a wide range of apps.
